title: Hayati Pro Max Berry Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Berry Lemonade blends a mix of sweet summer Berries with a splash of tangy Lemonade for a bright and fruity vape. The Berry flavour is rich and juicy, with a natural sweetness that’s lifted by the fizzy tang of Lemonade. Made with nicotine salts for rapid nicotine delivery and a more satisfying throat hit, this e-liquid is perfect for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and vape pens. Its 50VG/50PG blend delivers dependable flavour with discreet vapour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
